              then we can update dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[i-len(word)])
        
        This works because if we match a word ending at position i, we take the optimal solution 
        for the prefix before that word and add 0 extra characters for the matched word.
        
        Time Complexity: O(n^2 * m) where n = len(s), m
